text.heading: Main Insight
text.body: The system should support large source documents, extract text from every page, and generate a concise presentation by selecting from an approved template library. The main goal is to reduce manual presentation work while keeping strict control over brand assets, fonts, layout, and final PPTX quality.

text.heading: What This Means
text.body_left: The output should remain editable in PowerPoint and should not depend on Google Slides because custom fonts may break there. The workflow begins with a Next.js user interface.

text.body: The user uploads a PDF, enters a project name, chooses a target slide count, and optionally provides tone, audience, or brand notes. The default target is ten slides, but the system can adjust if the content clearly requires fewer or more.
